definitions.explanation: A postcard with a picture or photograph on one side, such as a view of a tourist spot or a reproduction of a painting, sold at sights, museums and souvenir shops.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅先|たびさき}→旅先：12949_tabisaki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{絵|え}はがき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I sent a picture postcard from my trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売店|ばいてん}→売店：01493_baiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絵|え}はがき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: At the museum shop I bought a few postcards of paintings I liked.

notes:
⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧ (picture) + ⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ (postcard). Also written {絵葉書|えはがき}. Counted with ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絵|え}はがき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ / ⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send a picture postcard
- {絵|え}はがき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: scenery as pretty as a postcard
- ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絵|え}はがき: a souvenir postcard
